{{Quote|I've got a daughter back home I wouldn't mind sending here.|Oniye Namada, Imperial Security Bureau report I-1822-VAK|<ref name="TF2" />}}
The '''daughter''' of [[Oniye Namada]] was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. In the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] report I-1822-VAK, Oniye Namada mentioned that she wouldn't mind letting her attend the [[Imperial Education Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]].<ref name="TF2" />
